files.workbench/model_exam.py: NEW. The paper format (graphite.exam-paper/1) in its docstring. The seven-part model key (file set, runtime pin, device, context, seal digest, template-rendering digest from three fixed conversations through /apply-template with thinking off and on, which tells SWITCHED_OFF / NO_THINKING / IGNORED; exam version over every paper's name, version and items sha256). key_for(worker) is cached per worker process. load_paper refuses a paper whose items do not hash to the sha256 frozen in paper.json, before any inference, and refuses a float in any item. sit() asks every item through turns.ask with the production kind and a fresh TurnRequest (MemoryLedger, every switch on). ExamPort holds an answer past late_ms. score() uses expect, harm and pull matchers, compares 1 and [1] alike (GOAL), counts tp/fp/fn for set items, and applies the MARKERS adapter for marked_by known items (READ.steps, READ.data, READ.asks, READ.must_not_act, WORDS.facts) as PAPERS.md describes. known.if_room items whose verbs the kind lacks are NOT RUN (IF_ROOM). NOT_SENT answers are kept out of a kind's window. Trust per kind per key over the last 20: EXAMINED at 19 or more right with harm 0; SWITCHED_OFF on any harm, or with 20 results below the floor (12, or the paper's own), in her words ("I'll stop asking it to read pages: it got 11 of 20 right."); CHANGED when the same item on the same key gets another answer ("Something changed under the model"). Stores: MemoryStore and KernelStore (tables brain_exam and brain_exam_runs, local only). The own paper is built by a lane-B builder when one exists (own_paper_items); its rows hold only digests, exportable() drops them, and summarise() and card() show only its count. agreement() gives "agreed with itself on x of y". BUILDERS for MARKS and ASK make page_marks.Page from the page text. Operation brain.exam (read). CLI: --list, and --seal DIR [--write].
files.workbench/model_check.py: NEW. python -B -m workbench.model_check --model FILE [--overnight] [--also FILE] [--plan]. The stages with their estimated times are printed first. It runs on an invented workspace (Work: a new Office under the run folder, using Graphite's own brain.model.add and brain.model.use, so prepare, probe, memory rule and seal are the real ones; removed at the end). It refuses to start on battery; Gate waits before each measurement while the pause file exists (the desk in use) or the computer is on battery, and takes a disturbed measurement again. S0 to S7 as in design 6.1; all model calls go through turns.LocalPort.complete or turns.ask, so turns.py stays the only caller of local_brain.completion. K7 is measured by resident memory growth over extending questions and counted in whole checkpoints of the computed size (the coordinator's point 2). S7 runs the full exam, then the shipped `python -B -m workbench.i05_arms --kit` with --pause-file and --mains-only, after check_registration (the coordinator's point 1). judge() gives K1 to K12 as held, not held or not measured (with why), the design 6.4 findings, and the proposals. card() is under 50 KB and ends "Her model on this machine: ...". privacy_scan() looks for paths beyond the model's file name, this computer's user and host names, the workspace and canaries (the own paper), plus voice_character.private_in on names. When it finds any of these, nothing is written for sending. use_setting() calls ledger.settings.set with the value the owner saw, and undo_setting() calls ledger.settings.undo. Writes for-sending/model-check-<date>.json and .txt, plus exam_results.local.json and own_results.local.json beside them (never for sending).
files.MODEL_CHECK.sh: NEW, executable: the console command (cd to the program folder; python3 -B -m workbench.model_check "$@").
files.workbench/model_check_qt.py: NEW. CheckPanel: the one button "Check her model on this machine", an overnight box and an own-paper box. It confirms first with the stage table and times, then runs the check as a QProcess with the selected model and the launch defaults on screen. A 1 s timer sets the pause file from the desk's own touch lease (resource_control.foreground). During S4 it measures its own event-loop gaps with a 10 ms timer and writes desk_stalls.json. It shows the card (exactly what would leave) and a "Show the folder" button. It writes the exam results into this computer's exam record (KernelStore), and offers "Use the measured settings?" with Use it and Undo per proposal. "Show the exam card" calls brain.exam.
files.workbench/brain_qt.py: two lines after the tab loop: the CheckPanel as a tab "Check her model".

decisions_where_the_design_was_silent: The floor below which a kind is switched off is 12 of 20 (60 %, from 7.4's "under 12 of 24" rule). A paper may set its own floor. The floor is judged only once 20 results are in.

A question the desk did not send (NOT_SENT: over its cap, over context) is not the model's answer: it is reported apart and kept out of the trust window. A LATE answer counts as not right, because the exam is of this model on this machine at her own deadlines.

The I05 additions' registration file is tests_integrated/data/i05/PREDICTIONS_087.md (shipped). REGISTERED in i05_arms.py holds its sha256 and the sha256 of the additions' definitions (arms rows, case E, compact briefs and forms, caps, E_ARMS).

Arm A and every 0.8.6 arm are launched with reuse off, so that they run as registered. This needed a launch option (reuse) in local_brain. cache_prompt is still sent on every request (local_brain always sends it), so a prompt that exactly extends the slot's last one can still be kept by the runtime.

B3+RG's compact mapping line is capped at 48 tokens (its grammar's worst case). The prediction "every turn writes at most 16 tokens" is measured, not enforced. The order test's trigger is "the model's pick is not the planner's own first step", because judgment.py has no ORDER (B6 is if room).

Batch 64, 256 and 512 are measured through a new launch option (batch). No owner setting exists for it, so "reading in batches of 512 is x times faster" is a finding, not a proposal. Proposals are limited to the owner's model launch defaults (brain.backend and the rest), applied with ledger.settings.set and undone with ledger.settings.undo.
The run folder is under Graphite's own settings folder (session.config_dir()/model-check/<stamp>), not in the workspace. Its for-sending/ subfolder holds the file to send.
The S4 desk stall uses the Brain room's own event-loop gaps (a 10 ms timer) during the check's 3,000-token read, as a stand-in for Field stalls.

The own paper is built in the Brain room (in-process, via a lane-B own_paper_items builder when one exists) and handed to the kit as a local file, which is deleted after the run. The console kit never opens the owner's workspace.

The coordinator's point 2: K7 uses resident memory growth counted in whole checkpoints of the computed size, with a residual. It checks the computed size against the growth; it is not an independent measure, and the report says so. In the dry run, the 4B grew by exactly 2 x 50.25 MiB, all at the first extending question.

MARKS and ASK items get the runner's own builder (page_marks.Page from the page text, titled by source). READ, GOAL, NEXT and FRAME need their lane's exam_inputs. Until they have one, their items are NOT RUN with why, never counted.
findings_for_other_lanes: MARKS (lane C): all 6 PAGES mark pages came back NOT_SENT OVER_CAP in the dry run (the page message over 1,000 new tokens, or the grammar over 140). The MARKS paper cannot be sat until the cap or the pages change.
ASK at its 6 s foreground deadline: 9 of 11 late with the 4B on a contended CPU (load 2.5 to 4).

READ (B3, merged on main as understand.py), GOAL (brief.py), NEXT (no kind registered: B6 is if room) and FRAME (C6c if room) have no exam_inputs. 110 of the 127 short items cannot be asked until their lanes add `exam_inputs(inputs, item)` in the kind's module (or a builders entry in paper.json). A READ builder needs understand.inputs from desks/*.json. Note that brief.goal() drops change options and renumbers, so a GOAL builder for STEER must keep the paper's numbering.
not_done: No new test files were written, and the test suite, the tiers and the tools/check_*_ui.py window checks were not run (the owner's rule). Nothing was tested in the owner's sense, and nothing ran on the owner's ThinkPad.

The dry run was with the 4B only (the design also names the 2B; the brief allows one run with the 4B). It ran on the processor: Vulkan, batches, GTT, the full seal on Vulkan and the GPU agreement double sitting did not run here. S4, S6 and S7 were not run (S7: the I05 arms and the full exam are the owner's overnight part).
No measurement campaign was run (exam, reuse bench, I05). The dry run's numbers are contended and are not rates.
The Brain room panel was imported but not constructed or clicked (window parts get no test beyond that, by the rule).
The YOUR OWN paper builder (own_paper_items) is lane B's. Until it exists, the own-paper box says it cannot be made in this build.
The design's "four-kind-slot arm" and "--n-cpu-moe" plan B are not built: they are launch lines Graphite does not make. They are reported as not run, with why.
